purpose: A complete, bounded CE-versus-Online-v2 comparison on a balanced 200-problem subset, sized for a 4-6 hour end-to-end run rather than the 4000-problem campaign.
estimand_limit: Within-family transfer from variants v001-v008 to the immediately following v009-v010 variants. This is not evidence about unscaffolded variants, unseen theorem families, or the original 4000-problem protocol.

selection.family_policy: all source families, exactly once per selected variant
selection.train_wave: one variant index across all 20 families; eight waves in v001-v008 order
selection.heldout_policy: v009-v010 may be read for execution only after both arms and all hyperparameters are locked; no replay, gradients, advantage, checkpoint selection, early stopping, or tuning may use them

arms.ce: official-style masked token CE on strictly Lean-verified selected search paths, retaining the CE64 value objective
arms.online_v2: fresh-wave problem-grouped clipped PPO with frozen rollout policy, behavior-distribution KL, verification-derived reward, and the same CE64 value objective
arms.common_start: byte-identical base model, value head, and initially zero-effect LoRA; cloned into independent optimizer, adapter, replay, and RNG state before either arm updates

randomness.generation_seed_rule: 20261005 + 100000*split_code + 1000*variant_index + 10*family_index + attempt_index; split_code is 1 for train and 2 for heldout; the same seed is used for the paired arm/task/attempt
randomness.claim_limit: one-seed result is a rapid paired comparison and must not be presented as a significance or robustness result

budget.wall_time_role: operational safety envelope only; it is not a substitute for matching generated-token and Lean-execution caps

stopping.task: stop launching attempts after the first strict Lean success or after four completed attempts; retain and charge every already-started request
stopping.wave: finish all already-started requests in the current 20-family wave before applying task stopping or checkpointing
stopping.arm: complete all eight train waves unless a frozen resource cap, numerical rollback guard, or hard failure fires
stopping.heldout: run every one of the 40 heldout tasks under the same four-attempt cap for each locked checkpoint; do not stop because an aggregate result looks favorable
stopping.wall_clock: at six end-to-end hours stop safely after persisting state and mark the comparison INCOMPLETE; do not calculate a final winner from unequal partial arms
stopping.infrastructure_error: retry once without assigning reward; if the same task still has an infrastructure error, persist diagnostics and mark the experiment INCOMPLETE
stopping.truncation_gate: if representative preflight truncation exceeds 5 percent, do not start the subset run; revise the declared token limit and create a new protocol revision
stopping.budget_exhaustion: if either arm exhausts a primary cap before all 160 train tasks, stop both at the last common completed wave and mark the planned complete comparison INCOMPLETE

reporting.primary_metric: strict Lean solve rate on the 40 heldout rows, macro-averaged across 20 families
reporting.paired_metric: per-family CE-minus-Online-v2 solve-rate difference over v009-v010
secondary_metrics: success versus generated-token and Lean-execution cost
invalid tactic, timeout, infrastructure-error, and truncation rates
KL, clip fraction, gradient norm, rollback count, and optimizer cost
reporting.required_terminal_state: DONE only if both arms finish all 160 train rows and every locked checkpoint finishes all 40 heldout rows; otherwise FAILED or INCOMPLETE with diagnostics
